scenes.chip: 1 · CAN A VIDEO CLIP BE EVIDENCE?

scenes.dialogue: Hi, I'm Ravishankar from LawWorld. Today: electronic evidence, and the certificate under Section Sixty Three of the Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam.
scenes.shown: Hi, I'm Ravishankar from LawWorld. Today: electronic evidence, and the certificate under Section 63 of the Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam.

scenes.dialogue: It replaced Section Sixty Five B of the old Evidence Act in July twenty twenty four.
scenes.shown: It replaced Section 65B of the old Evidence Act in July 2024.

scenes.dialogue: Take a hypothetical. Nisha's bakery in Belagavi is burgled at night, and her C C T V camera records it.
scenes.shown: Take a hypothetical. Nisha's bakery in Belagavi is burgled at night, and her CCTV camera records it.

scenes.dialogue: Police copy the footage onto a pen drive. They also rely on WhatsApp chats and call records.
Are these documents? Yes. Under Section Two, sub section One, clause D, a document includes electronic and digital records.
scenes.shown: Are these documents? Yes. Under Section 2(1)(d), a document includes electronic and digital records.

scenes.dialogue: Section Sixty One bars refusing a record only because it is electronic. But Section Sixty Three still applies.
scenes.shown: Section 61 bars refusing a record only because it is electronic. But Section 63 still applies.

scenes.dialogue: Primary evidence is the document itself. Section Fifty Seven now adds explanations for electronic records.
scenes.shown: Primary evidence is the document itself. Section 57 now adds explanations for electronic records.

scenes.dialogue: Where a record sits in multiple files or storage spaces, even temporary ones, each is primary evidence.
And so is a record produced from proper custody, unless it is disputed.
But Nisha's pen drive holds a copy from the D V R. It is a computer output, governed by Section Sixty Three.
scenes.shown: But Nisha's pen drive holds a copy from the DVR. It is a computer output, governed by Section 63.

scenes.dialogue: Sub section One deems a computer output a document, admissible without the original, if the conditions are met.
scenes.shown: Sub-section (1) deems a computer output a document, admissible without the original, if the conditions are met.

scenes.dialogue: Sub section Two lists them. The device was regularly used by the person in lawful control, and such information was regularly fed in.
scenes.shown: Sub-section (2) lists them. The device was regularly used by the person in lawful control, and such information was regularly fed in.

scenes.dialogue: It worked properly, or a fault did not affect the record. And the record reproduces, or derives from, what was fed in.
Sub section Four requires a certificate. It identifies the record, explains how it was produced, describes the device, and addresses those conditions.
scenes.shown: Sub-section (4) requires a certificate. It identifies the record, explains how it was produced, describes the device, and addresses those conditions.

scenes.dialogue: It is signed by a person in charge of the device or relevant activities, and also by an expert. That is new.
It must accompany the record at each submission for admission, and may be stated to the best of knowledge and belief.
The Schedule gives the form: Part A for the party, and Part B for the expert. Both identify the source device.
In Part A, the party affirms lawful control, regular use and proper working, and whether they own, manage or operate it.
For the bakery footage, Nisha, who runs the D V R, could sign Part A, and an expert Part B.
scenes.shown: For the bakery footage, Nisha, who runs the DVR, could sign Part A, and an expert Part B.

scenes.dialogue: Both parts also state the record's hash value, and the algorithm used to calculate it. A hash report is enclosed.
A hash value is a short code calculated from a file's contents. Change even one character, and the hash value changes.
So if the copy in court gives the same hash value, the data has not changed since the certificate recorded it.
In May twenty twenty six, the Supreme Court declined a challenge to this rule. It called a hash value an electronic fingerprint, ensuring integrity.
scenes.shown: In May 2026, the Supreme Court declined a challenge to this rule. It called a hash value an electronic fingerprint, ensuring integrity.

scenes.dialogue: It also observed that, besides notified examiners, a person the court finds skilled in cyber forensics may sign Part B, but kept the question open.
In twenty fourteen, a three judge bench of the Supreme Court held the old Section Sixty Five B certificate mandatory for secondary electronic evidence.
scenes.shown: In 2014, a three-judge bench of the Supreme Court held the old Section 65B certificate mandatory for secondary electronic evidence.

scenes.dialogue: Electronic records are more open to tampering, so the certificate safeguards their source and authenticity.
In twenty twenty, another three judge bench called it a condition precedent. Oral evidence cannot replace it.
scenes.shown: In 2020, another three-judge bench called it a condition precedent. Oral evidence cannot replace it.

scenes.dialogue: It held a certificate unnecessary when the original is produced, as when a phone's owner enters the witness box and proves the device is his.
What if the person who must sign refuses? The party can apply to the court, which can summon that person to produce it.
In criminal trials, electronic evidence must reach the accused before the trial begins, so a defence can be prepared.
Until the hearing ends, the judge may still allow a certificate later, if the accused is not seriously prejudiced.
A WhatsApp screenshot or email printout is a computer output too. Without a proper certificate, it risks exclusion.
Call records come from the service provider's system, so its responsible officer should certify them. Providers keep them only for a limited time.
Common mistakes? A screenshot with no certificate, a signer with no responsibility for the device, or no expert part.
Under Section One Seventy, trials, investigations and other proceedings pending when the Adhiniyam began continue under the old Evidence Act.
scenes.shown: Under Section 170, trials, investigations and other proceedings pending when the Adhiniyam began continue under the old Evidence Act.
scenes.chip: 10 · OLD ACT OR NEW? YOUR CHECKLIST

scenes.dialogue: Finally, a quick checklist. Check which law applies, preserve the original device, and make the copy with its hash value.
Get Part A signed by the person in charge, Part B by an expert, and file the certificate with every submission.
